comment: A suite outside the suites of every mutant (AWarmupTests) switches on a cache once per process, so the body of price(_:) runs in the first run of all tests and not in a later run. With --select-tests reach --shared-process, the second run without mutants at the start of the shared process runs only BPriceTests: the switches in the body are evaluated in the first run and not in the second, and their mutants go to a process of their own. The verdicts are those of one process per mutant, with and without --no-narrow-gate.
